court: In the High Court of Madras†
respondents: District Collector, Kancheepuram District and Others … Respondent(s).
advocates: For Respondent(s): Mrs. S. Anitha, SGP for R 1 & 6
judgment_text:
Prayer Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of India, praying to issue a writ of mandamus, directing the 5th Respondent to consider the petitioners representation dated 17-2-2020 and to grant loan in favour of the petitioner as per the official letter dated 12-11-2018 issued by the 6th Respondent to the 5th respondent

ORDER

This writ petition has been filed to direct the respondents to consider the petitioner's representation dated 17-2-2020.

2. The learned counsel for the petitioner would submit that in this case, the petitioner has given a representation dated 17-2-2020 requesting the respondents to grant loan in favour of the petitioner as per the official letter dated 12-11-2018 issued by the 6th respondent to the 5th respondent. However, the said representation was not at all considered by the respondents till date. Hence, this petition.

3. In reply, the learned counsel appearing for the respondent would submit that the petitioner's representation will be disposed of by the 5th respondent within a period of 4 weeks.

4. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned counsel appearing for the respondent and also perused the entire materials available on record.

5. In view of the above, without expressing any opinion on the merits of the matter, this Court directs the 5th respondent to consider the representation of the petitioner dated 17-2-2020 and dispose of the same, after issuing due notice to the petitioner, on merits and in accordance with law, within a period of 4 weeks from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.

6. With the above directions, this writ petition is disposed of. No cost.
